title: CityReportBoard
description: The API provides two endpoints for a city-based report board. Users submit a report with a location string and receive an authentication token and a report identifier. The location is parsed to determine the city using a comma-based rule: the last comma‑separated segment is taken as the city (whitespace trimmed). Users can later retrieve a list of reports limited to their own city by supplying the authentication token. Reports include a public profile identifier for the author, content, and city.
declared_purpose: To allow users to share reports with other users registered in the same city.
allowed_data_use: Process the location to extract city; display reports only to authenticated users whose city matches the report’s city; use email internally for account management; author identification via public profile_id.
forbidden_data_use: Must not expose email or precise location to any user; must not return reports when the requester’s city does not match the report’s city.
allowed_storage: Email (for account management), extracted city, report content, public profile_id, and authentication token may be stored persistently. Resource content and access-control rules (city ownership) may be stored.
forbidden_storage: Exact latitude, longitude, GPS coordinates, street address, full address, and the original location string must not be stored, returned, retained, or exposed.
expected_privacy_preserving_behavior: API responses contain no email or precise location. GET /reports only returns reports whose city matches the authenticated user’s city. The database does not contain any original location string or precise address; only the extracted city is stored. The public profile_id is not an email.
expected_privacy_violating_behavior: Email or precise location appears in an API response. The database contains an original location string or full address. GET /reports returns reports from other cities. Unauthenticated requests successfully list reports.
schema:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: CityReportBoard
  description: API for submitting city-based reports and retrieving reports by city using an authentication token.
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /reports:
    post:
      summary: Submit a new report
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                location:
                  type: string
                  description: A location string; the city is extracted as the last comma-separated segment (whitespace trimmed).
                  example: "123 Main St, Springfield, IL"
                content:
                  type: string
                  description: The report content.
                  example: "Pothole on Main Street"
                profile_id:
                  type: string
                  description: Public identifier for the author.
                  example: "user123"
              required:
                - location
                - content
                - profile_id
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Report submitted successfully.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  token:
                    type: string
                    description: Authentication token that grants access to reports from the same city.
                    example: "abc123citytoken"
                  report_id:
                    type: string
                    description: Unique identifier for the submitted report.
                    example: "rep-456"
        '400':
          description: Invalid input.
    get:
      summary: Retrieve reports for the city associated with the provided token
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: token
          schema:
            type: string
          required: true
          description: Authentication token obtained from a previous report submission.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A list of reports for the city.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    report_id:
                      type: string
                      example: "rep-456"
                    profile_id:
                      type: string
                      example: "user123"
                    content:
                      type: string
                      example: "Pothole on Main Street"
                    city:
                      type: string
                      example: "IL"
        '400':
          description: Invalid or missing token.
        '401':
          description: Invalid token.
text_spec:
The server, named CityReportBoard, provides two endpoints for submitting and retrieving city-based reports. The first endpoint, accessible via POST /reports, allows users to submit a new report. The request body must be a JSON object containing three required fields: "location" (a string describing the location), "content" (the report text), and "profile_id" (a public identifier for the author). The server extracts the city from the location string by taking the last comma-separated segment and trimming whitespace. Upon successful submission, the server responds with status 201 and a JSON object containing two fields: "token", an authentication token that grants access to reports from the same city, and "report_id", a unique identifier for the submitted report. If the input is invalid, a 400 status is returned.

The second endpoint, accessible via GET /reports, retrieves all reports associated with the city linked to a given authentication token. The request must include a query parameter "token" containing the token obtained from a previous report submission. The server responds with status 200 and a JSON array of report objects. Each object includes "report_id", "profile_id", "content", and "city" (the extracted city string). If the token is missing or invalid, the server returns a 400 status; if the token is invalid (e.g., not recognized), a 401 status is returned.
tests_spec:
- Description: Submit a report with a location containing commas and verify the token retrieves the correct report with the extracted city.
- Action:
  1. POST /reports with body `{"location":"123 Main St, Springfield, IL","content":"Pothole on Main St","profile_id":"user123"}`.
  2. Capture the token and report_id from the 201 response.
  3. GET /reports?token=<captured_token>.
- Expected behavior:
  - POST returns 201 with a JSON object that includes a non‑empty string field `token` and a non‑empty string field `report_id`.
  - GET returns 200 with a JSON array containing exactly one object.
  - That object contains `report_id` equal to the captured value, `profile_id` equal to `"user123"`, `content` equal to `"Pothole on Main St"`, and `city` equal to `"IL"`.

- Description: Tokens from different cities only retrieve reports matching the token’s city; reports in the same city are visible across different submitters.
- Action:
  1. POST /reports with body `{"location":"Boston, MA","content":"Report A","profile_id":"alice"}`. Keep `tokenA`.
  2. POST /reports with body `{"location":"Worcester, MA","content":"Report B","profile_id":"bob"}`. (Optional: keep tokenB)
  3. POST /reports with body `{"location":"Austin, TX","content":"Report C","profile_id":"charlie"}`. Keep `tokenC`.
  4. GET /reports?token=<tokenA>.
  5. GET /reports?token=<tokenC>.
- Expected behavior:
  - All POSTs return 201.
  - GET with `tokenA` returns 200 with a JSON array containing exactly two objects:
    * one with `profile_id` `"alice"`, `content` `"Report A"`, `city` `"MA"`
    * one with `profile_id` `"bob"`, `content` `"Report B"`, `city` `"MA"`
    (order not important).
  - GET with `tokenC` returns 200 with a JSON array containing exactly one object: `profile_id` `"charlie"`, `content` `"Report C"`, `city` `"TX"`.

- Description: Verify that leading and trailing whitespace are trimmed from the extracted city.
- Action:
  1. POST /reports with body `{"location":"123 Main St, Springfield   ,  IL  ","content":"trim test","profile_id":"user1"}`.
  2. Capture the token.
  3. GET /reports?token=<captured_token>.
- Expected behavior:
  - POST returns 201.
  - GET returns 200 with an array containing exactly one object, and that object’s `city` field equals `"IL"` (no leading or trailing spaces).

- Description: Submitting a report without the required `location` field must be rejected.
- Action: POST /reports with body `{"content":"some text","profile_id":"user1"}` (omitting `location`).
- Expected behavior: Response status code is 4xx (e.g., 400).

- Description: Submitting a report without the required `content` field must be rejected.
- Action: POST /reports with body `{"location":"Somewhere, NY","profile_id":"user1"}`.
- Expected behavior: Response status code is 4xx.

- Description: Submitting a report without the required `profile_id` field must be rejected.
- Action: POST /reports with body `{"location":"Somewhere, NY","content":"text"}`.
- Expected behavior: Response status code is 4xx.

- Description: Requesting reports without providing a token query parameter must be rejected.
- Action: GET /reports (no `token` parameter).
- Expected behavior: Response status code is 4xx (e.g., 400).

- Description: Requesting reports with an invalid token (not obtained from any report submission) must be rejected.
- Action: GET /reports?token=some-fake-token-0000.
- Expected behavior: Response status code is 4xx (e.g., 401).

def test_submit_and_retrieve_report(app: AppInstance) -> bool:
    resp = post_report(app, "123 Main St, Springfield, IL", "Pothole on Main St", "user123")
    if resp.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning("POST /reports expected 201, got %d", resp.status_code)
        return False
    data = resp.json()
    token = data.get("token")
    report_id = data.get("report_id")
    if not token or not isinstance(token, str) or not token.strip():
        app.logger.warning("token missing or empty")
        return False
    if not report_id or not isinstance(report_id, str) or not report_id.strip():
        app.logger.warning("report_id missing or empty")
        return False
    resp_get = get_reports(app, token)
    if resp_get.status_code != 200:
        app.logger.warning("GET /reports expected 200, got %d", resp_get.status_code)
        return False
    reports = resp_get.json()
    if not isinstance(reports, list) or len(reports) != 1:
        app.logger.warning("Expected exactly one report, got %s", reports)
        return False
    report = reports[0]
    if report.get("report_id") != report_id:
        app.logger.warning("report_id mismatch: expected %s, got %s", report_id, report.get("report_id"))
        return False
    if report.get("profile_id") != "user123":
        app.logger.warning("profile_id mismatch")
        return False
    if report.get("content") != "Pothole on Main St":
        app.logger.warning("content mismatch")
        return False
    if report.get("city") != "IL":
        app.logger.warning("city mismatch: expected IL, got %s", report.get("city"))
        return False
    return True

def test_city_isolation_and_visibility(app: AppInstance) -> bool:
    respA = post_report(app, "Boston, MA", "Report A", "alice")
    if respA.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning("POST A failed: %d", respA.status_code)
        return False
    tokenA = respA.json().get("token")
    if not tokenA:
        app.logger.warning("tokenA missing")
        return False

    respB = post_report(app, "Worcester, MA", "Report B", "bob")
    if respB.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning("POST B failed: %d", respB.status_code)
        return False

    respC = post_report(app, "Austin, TX", "Report C", "charlie")
    if respC.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning("POST C failed: %d", respC.status_code)
        return False
    tokenC = respC.json().get("token")
    if not tokenC:
        app.logger.warning("tokenC missing")
        return False

    getA = get_reports(app, tokenA)
    if getA.status_code != 200:
        app.logger.warning("GET with tokenA failed: %d", getA.status_code)
        return False
    reportsA = getA.json()
    if len(reportsA) != 2:
        app.logger.warning("Expected 2 reports for MA, got %d", len(reportsA))
        return False
    found_alice = any(r.get("profile_id") == "alice" and r.get("content") == "Report A" and r.get("city") == "MA" for r in reportsA)
    found_bob = any(r.get("profile_id") == "bob" and r.get("content") == "Report B" and r.get("city") == "MA" for r in reportsA)
    if not (found_alice and found_bob):
        app.logger.warning("Missing expected reports in MA list: %s", reportsA)
        return False

    getC = get_reports(app, tokenC)
    if getC.status_code != 200:
        app.logger.warning("GET with tokenC failed: %d", getC.status_code)
        return False
    reportsC = getC.json()
    if len(reportsC) != 1:
        app.logger.warning("Expected 1 report for TX, got %d", len(reportsC))
        return False
    reportC = reportsC[0]
    if reportC.get("profile_id") != "charlie" or reportC.get("content") != "Report C" or reportC.get("city") != "TX":
        app.logger.warning("Report C mismatch: %s", reportC)
        return False
    return True

def test_city_whitespace_trimming(app: AppInstance) -> bool:
    resp = post_report(app, "123 Main St, Springfield   ,  IL  ", "trim test", "user1")
    if resp.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning("POST failed: %d", resp.status_code)
        return False
    token = resp.json().get("token")
    if not token:
        app.logger.warning("token missing")
        return False
    get_resp = get_reports(app, token)
    if get_resp.status_code != 200:
        app.logger.warning("GET failed: %d", get_resp.status_code)
        return False
    reports = get_resp.json()
    if len(reports) != 1:
        app.logger.warning("Expected 1 report, got %d", len(reports))
        return False
    city = reports[0].get("city")
    if city != "IL":
        app.logger.warning("Expected city 'IL', got '%s'", city)
        return False
    return True
